# Figure 5

## 5B/C

These analyses were performed in Python (3.10.0). See script #TODO for reproducing the plots.

## 5E

```{r}
# Here we subset TCGA KIRC to patients with H&E information
TCGA_SE_HE <- TCGA_SE[,!is.na(TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_HE)]
TCGA_DST_HE <- TCGA_DST[,!is.na(TCGA_DST$survival_ecotype_HE)]

# Display gene signatures for survival ecotypes
GOI_rel <- c(gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_poor, gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_favorable)

# Define heatmap based on normalized counts 
df <- t(assay(TCGA_DST_HE)[GOI_rel,]) %>% as.data.frame 
df <- df %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
df$survival_ecotype_HE <- TCGA_DST_HE$survival_ecotype_HE[match(df$PID, colnames(TCGA_DST_HE))]
mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(df)-1), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_HE, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs)) %>% na.omit()
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("survival_ecotype_HE")

## Create annotations
anno <- df %>% dplyr::select(survival_ecotype_HE) %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_HE) %>% dplyr::count() %>% na.omit()
anno <- anno[match(anno$survival_ecotype_HE, rownames(ht)),]
ca <- data.frame(genes = colnames(ht))
ca$cat <- ifelse(ca$genes %in% gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_poor, "Poor", "Favorable")
gene_col <- setNames(c("#CA0020", "#0571B0"), rev(unique(ca$cat)))
c_anno <- columnAnnotation(cat = ca$cat, col = list(cat = gene_col))

## Print heatmap 
Heatmap(scale(ht), 
        name = "Scaled mean Z-scores", 
        show_column_names = FALSE, 
        bottom_annotation = c_anno)+
  rowAnnotation(n = anno_barplot(anno$n, gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")))+
  rowAnnotation(anno = anno_text(anno$survival_ecotype_HE))
```

## 5F

```{r}
# Perform nearest template prediction for survival ecotypes in full TCGA KIRC cohort
## Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(TCGA_SE)$tpm_unstrand 
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat) <- rowData(TCGA_SE)$gene_name

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
POORUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_poor
FAVUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_favorable
names(FAVUP) <- rep("FAV", length(FAVUP))
names(POORUP) <- rep("POOR", length(POORUP))
keyup <- c(FAVUP, POORUP)
template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
set.seed(22)
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  doPlot = TRUE
)

# Step 4: Convert predictions into groups
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.01, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(TCGA_SE$PID, ntp_out$PID)]
TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "POOR"] <- "Poor"
TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "NOT"] <- "Medium"
TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "FAV"] <- "Favorable"
TCGA_DST$survival_ecotype_gene <- TCGA_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[match(TCGA_DST$PID, TCGA_SE$PID)]

# Step 5: Show survival trends
surv_out <- colData(TCGA_SE) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, OS_days, status_OS, survival_ecotype_gene) %>% unique()
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_days, status_OS) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0","gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

## S9E

```{r}
# HE clusters per PID 
HE_check <- HE_cluster_anno %>% group_by(cluster, PID) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n))
HE_count <- HE_check %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = cluster, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% ungroup()
HE_frac <- HE_check %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = cluster, values_from = fra, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% ungroup()

# 1. MEAN
## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df <- HE_frac
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}
colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),metadata_selected$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),metadata_selected$PID)]

covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)
plot_df_dens_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

# 2. MEDIAN
## MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL
Cox_df_median <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(median = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > median(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(median)
}
colnames(Cox_df_median) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_median) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_median <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_median)
Cox_df_median$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),metadata_selected$PID)]
Cox_df_median$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),metadata_selected$PID)]

covariates <- Cox_df_median %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_median)
multi_res <- summary(multi_model)
plot_df_dens_median <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],3))

# Combined visualization
cox_median <- plot_df_dens_median %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_median$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_median$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "median") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_median$group <- factor(cox_median$group, levels = cox_median$group)
cox_mean <- plot_df_dens_mean %>% mutate(sign = p_value < 0.05, result = ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR > 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(plot_df_dens_mean$HR < 1 & plot_df_dens_mean$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% mutate(category = "mean") %>% arrange(desc(HR))
cox_mean$group <- factor(cox_mean$group, levels = cox_mean$group)

plot_cox_combined <- rbind(cox_mean, cox_median)
plot_cox_combined$type <- "HE clusters"
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG")
both <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group,result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(group) %>% unfactor()
plot_cox_combined_fil$category <- ifelse(plot_cox_combined_fil$group %in% both, "both", plot_cox_combined_fil$category)
plot_cox_combined_fil <- plot_cox_combined_fil %>% group_by(group, category) %>% reframe(HR = mean(HR), p_value = mean(p_value), result = result, type = type) %>% unique()

ggplot(plot_cox_combined_fil, aes(x=reorder(group,HR), y = type, shape = category, col = HR, size= -log10(p_value)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15,17))+
  new_scale(new_aes = "shape")+
  new_scale(new_aes = "color") +
  geom_point(data = plot_cox_combined_fil,aes(size = -log10(p_value), shape = category, col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(0,2))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Cox model")+
  coord_flip()
```

## S9F

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
general_count_wide <- HE_count %>% t() 

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){
abundances <- general_count_wide
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
meta <- as.data.frame(metadata_selected[match(colnames(abundances), metadata_selected$PID),])
ref_levels <- c(
  "necrose"       = "NE0",
  "ISUP_combined" = "G1/2",
  "pT_combined"   = "T1/2",
  "PDL1_score"    = "PD0"
)
if (x %in% names(ref_levels)) {
  meta[, x] <- relevel(x = factor(meta[, x]), ref = ref_levels[[x]])
}
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = as.matrix(meta[,x]))
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))
DA <- res$table
DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table
DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))
DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x
return(DA)
})
DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)

# Filter
HE_diff_abun <- DA_out %>% filter(sign == TRUE) %>% group_by(cluster, result) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n >= 2) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique() %>% unfactor()
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score", "necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
DA_out_fil <- DA_out[DA_out$cluster %in% HE_diff_abun, ]

ggplot(DA_out_fil, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out_fil,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  ylab("Disease progression")
```

## S9G

```{r}
# Create list from results
cv_results_list <- list(
  "HE" = BF_HE_HE,
  "IMC" = BF_HE_IMC,
  "IMC_HE" = BF_HE_IMC_HE
)

# Define colors 
col_cv <- setNames(c("grey","firebrick1", "purple4"),
c("HE", "IMC", "IMC_HE"))

# INTEGRATED BRIER SCORE
# Initialize list to store IBS scores for each cross-validation result
ibs_scores_list <- list()
ibs_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    if (nrow(res$actual_surv) != nrow(res$actual_test)) {
      stop("Row count mismatch between actual_surv and actual_test")
    }
    test_data <- cbind(res$actual_surv, res$actual_test)
    times_test <- sort(unique(test_data$OS_months))
    if(!0 %in% times_test){
    times_test <- c(0, times_test) 
    }
    times_pred <- res$predictions$unique.death.times
    time_indices <- sapply(times_test, function(t) which.min(abs(times_pred - t)))
    aligned_surv_probs <- res$predictions$survival[, time_indices, drop = FALSE]
    pec_obj <- pec(
      object = list("BlockForest" = aligned_surv_probs),
      formula = Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1,
      cens.model = "marginal",
      exact = TRUE,
      data = test_data
    )
    IBSrange <- quantile(test_data$OS_months, 0.9)
    crps_val <- crps(pec_obj, start = 0, times = IBSrange)
    ibs_score <- crps_val[2] #
    return(ibs_score)
  })
})
out_ibs <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", ibs_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "IBS")

# Plot
ggplot(out_ibs, aes(x = reorder(model,-IBS, FUN = median), y = IBS, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "HE", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Integrated Brier Score")

# CONCORDANCE
# Initialize list to store concordance scores for each cross-validation result
concordance_scores_list <- list()
concordance_scores_list <- lapply(cv_results_list, function(res_obj) {
  sapply(res_obj, function(res) {
    out <- concordance(Surv(res$actual_surv[, 1], res$actual_surv[, 2]) ~ rowSums(res$predictions$survival), timewt = "n/G2")
    return(out$concordance)
  })
})
out_concordance <- data.frame(fold = 1:10, t(do.call("rbind", concordance_scores_list))[1:10,]) %>% pivot_longer(2:ncol(.), names_to = "model", values_to = "concordance")

ggplot(out_concordance, aes(x = reorder(model,concordance, FUN = median), y = concordance, fill = model))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "HE", paired = FALSE, method = "t.test", method.args = list(alternative = "greater", label = "p.format"))+
  stat_compare_means(vjust = 1, method = "anova")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cv)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("Models")+
  ylab("Concordance (Uno)")
```

## S9I

```{r}
# 1. DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS
# Create DESeqDataset
ddsSE_1 <- DESeqDataSet(TCGA_SE_HE, design = ~ survival_ecotype_HE)
# Filter genes
## 1: Lowly expressed genes
summary(rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10)
keep <- rowSums(counts(ddsSE_1)) >= 10
ddsSE_1 <- ddsSE_1[keep, ]
## 2: Filter for protein-coding genes
ddsSE_1 <- ddsSE_1[rowData(ddsSE_1)$gene_type == "protein_coding", ]
# Perform DESeq analysis 
dds <- DESeq(ddsSE_1, )
rownames(dds) <- rowData(dds)$gene_name

# 2. GENE-SET ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS
set.seed(22)
organism <- "org.Hs.eg.db"

## A. POOR
res_ICAM_vs_MTOR <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Poor", "Favorable"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
res_ICAM_vs_not_icam_vhl <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Poor", "Medium"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
## Poor vs Favorable
original_gene_list <- res_ICAM_vs_MTOR$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_ICAM_vs_MTOR)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) 
gse_1 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
## Poor vs Medium
original_gene_list <- res_ICAM_vs_not_icam_vhl$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_ICAM_vs_not_icam_vhl)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) 
gse_2 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
# Shared
out_gse_sup1 <- as.data.frame(gse_1) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "suppVSact", category = "Poor")
out_gse_sup2 <- as.data.frame(gse_2) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "suppVSmedium", category = "Poor")
shared <- intersect(out_gse_sup1$Description, out_gse_sup2$Description)
out_gse_sup <- rbind(out_gse_sup1, out_gse_sup2) 
out_gse_sup <- out_gse_sup %>% filter(Description %in% shared) %>%
  group_by(ID, Description, category) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

## B. FAVORABLE
res_mtor_vs_not_icam_vhl <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Favorable", "Medium"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
res_mtor_vs_icam <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Favorable", "Poor"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
# Favorable vs Medium
original_gene_list <- res_mtor_vs_not_icam_vhl$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_mtor_vs_not_icam_vhl)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
gse_1 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
# Favorable vs Poor
original_gene_list <- res_mtor_vs_icam $log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_mtor_vs_icam )
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) 
gse_2 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
# Shared
out_gse_act1 <- as.data.frame(gse_1) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "actVSmedium", category = "Favorable")
out_gse_act2 <- as.data.frame(gse_2) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "actVSactp", category = "Favorable")
shared <- intersect(out_gse_act1$Description, out_gse_act2$Description)
out_gse_act <- rbind(out_gse_act1, out_gse_act2) 
out_gse_act <- out_gse_act %>% filter(Description %in% shared) %>% 
  group_by(ID, Description, category) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")
## C. Medium
res_not_icam_vhl_vs_ICAM <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Medium", "Poor"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
res_not_icam_vs_MTOR <- results(dds,
  contrast = c("survival_ecotype_HE", "Medium", "Favorable"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfcThreshold = 1
)
# Medium vs. Poor
original_gene_list <- res_not_icam_vhl_vs_ICAM$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_not_icam_vhl_vs_ICAM)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) 
gse_1 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
# Medium vs. Favorable
original_gene_list <- res_not_icam_vs_MTOR$log2FoldChange
names(original_gene_list) <- rownames(res_not_icam_vs_MTOR)
gene_list <- na.omit(original_gene_list)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE) 
gse_2 <- gseGO(geneList=gene_list, 
             ont ="BP", 
             keyType = "SYMBOL", 
             minGSSize = 50, 
             maxGSSize = 1000, 
             pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
             verbose = TRUE, 
             OrgDb = organism, 
             pAdjustMethod = "BH")
# Shared
out_gse_medium1 <- as.data.frame(gse_1) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "mediumVSsup", category = "Medium")
out_gse_medium2 <- as.data.frame(gse_2) %>% filter(enrichmentScore > 0) %>% mutate(test = "mediumVSact", category = "Medium")
shared <- intersect(out_gse_medium1$Description, out_gse_medium2$Description)
out_gse_medium <- rbind(out_gse_medium1, out_gse_medium2) 
out_gse_medium <- out_gse_medium %>% filter(Description %in% shared) %>% 
  group_by(ID, Description, category) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

# 3. COMBINE ALL RESULTS
out_gse_all <- rbind(out_gse_act %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% dplyr::slice(1:10), 
                     out_gse_sup %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% dplyr::slice(1:10), 
                     out_gse_medium %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% dplyr::slice(1:10))

# Plot
ggplot(out_gse_all,
       aes(x = category,
           y = reorder_within(Description, -p.adjust, category),
           col = enrichmentScore,
           size = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_reordered() + 
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", low = "white")
```

## S9J

```{r}
chrom_sig_up <- gene_signatures$chromosomal_instability_Carter

# Filter for available genes
chrom_sig_up_rel <- chrom_sig_up[chrom_sig_up %in% rownames(assay(TCGA_DST_HE))]
df <- t(assay(TCGA_DST_HE)[chrom_sig_up_rel ,]) %>% as.data.frame
df <- as.data.frame(scale(df))
df$signature_sum <- rowSums(df,na.rm = TRUE)
df$survival_ecotype_HE <- TCGA_DST_HE$survival_ecotype_HE[match(rownames(df), colnames(TCGA_DST_HE))]
df <- df[!is.na(df$survival_ecotype_HE),]

col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))

# Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = survival_ecotype_HE, y = signature_sum, fill = survival_ecotype_HE))+
  geom_point(aes(color = survival_ecotype_HE))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_group)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_group)+
  theme_classic()+
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none")+
  ylab("Chromosomal instability (Carter et al.)")+
  stat_compare_means()
```

## S10C

```{r}
# Define GOI of interest
GOI <- c("NFKB1", "CCND1", "MTOR", "VHL", "ICAM1", "CD44")
GOI_rel <- GOI[GOI %in% rownames(TCGA_DST)]

# Define heatmap based on normalized counts 
df <- t(assay(TCGA_DST)[GOI_rel,]) %>% as.data.frame 
df <- df %>% rownames_to_column("PID")

## Create heatmap body 
df$survival_ecotype_gene <- TCGA_DST$survival_ecotype_gene[match(df$PID, colnames(TCGA_DST))]
mat <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:(ncol(df)-1), names_to = "gene", values_to = "exprs") %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_gene, gene) %>% summarize(mean = mean(exprs)) %>% na.omit()
ht <- mat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "gene", values_from = "mean") %>% column_to_rownames("survival_ecotype_gene")

## Annotations
anno <- df %>% dplyr::select(survival_ecotype_gene) %>% group_by(survival_ecotype_gene) %>% dplyr::count() %>% na.omit()
anno <- anno[match(anno$survival_ecotype_gene, rownames(ht)),]
col_anno <- data.frame(gene = colnames(ht))
col_anno$cat <- ifelse(col_anno$gene %in% c("ICAM1", "CD44"), "poor", "good")
cat_col_sub <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "#CA0020"), c("good", "poor"))

## Print heatmap 
Heatmap(scale(ht), name = "Scaled mean Z-scores", 
        column_split = col_anno$cat, 
        top_annotation = columnAnnotation(cat = anno_simple(col_anno$cat, col = cat_col_sub)), 
        show_column_dend = FALSE)+
  rowAnnotation(n = anno_barplot(anno$n, gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF")))+
  rowAnnotation(anno = anno_text(anno$survival_ecotype_gene))
```
